videos.title: The Pacific War in Color
videos.description: President Harry Truman decides to drop the atomic bomb on Hiroshima and Nagasaki; Emperor Hirohito surrenders, and Gen. Douglas MacArthur arrives to oversee the country's occupation; mortal enemies must now become partners in Japan's rebirth.

videos.title: Apocalypse: The Second World War
videos.description: Hitler unleashes the full wrath of his military might.

videos.title: Apocalypse: World War II
videos.description: The darkest days of the war are covered; Germany conquers France; British civilians endure the Blitz.

videos.title: Apocalypse: The Second World War
videos.description: As the war continues into 1941, the conflict goes truly global with the savage battle for Moscow and Japan's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor.

videos.title: Air Warriors
videos.description: A look at how the C-47 evolved from passenger plane to a transport aircraft and flying hospital in WWII and years later as a gunship in Vietnam.

videos.title: Battle of Midway: The True Story
videos.description: America's first victory in the Pacific during World War II is retold from the vantage point of the three U.S. attack planes as they overcame the enemy ambush to face off against the Mitsubishi A6M Zero, a long-range fighter, in the air.

videos.title: The Battle of Normandy: 85 Days in Hell
videos.description: On D-Day, Allied forces land in Normandy, France, to beat back the German troops and liberate France; previously unseen archival footage captures the 85-day struggle to liberate Europe and includes rare images of the battle itself.

videos.title: The Blitz: Days That Changed WWII
videos.description: The story of Nazi Germany's unprecedented aerial assault on Britain's major cities and how the resilience of its citizens became a news event.

videos.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids
videos.description: British Commandos raid two occupied Norwegian islands to wipe out fish oil factories used to make explosives.

videos.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids
videos.description: An elite group of British paratroopers launch a midnight raid in order to capture Hitler's unusual radar equipment.

videos.title: Apocalypse: World War II
videos.description: The darkest days of the war are covered; Germany conquers France; British civilians endure the Blitz.

videos.title: Race to Victory: WWII Europe
videos.description: First-person accounts and rare color footage detail the final 100 days of World War II in Europe.

videos.title: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
videos.description: In 1944, the Allied invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe brings the hope of freedom and the devastation of war to the people of France.

videos.title: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
videos.description: New colorized footage and testimony reveal the cost paid by the Allies and civilians to free Belgium and the Netherlands from Nazi occupation.

videos.title: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
videos.description: In late 1944, Hitler forces the Americans into their biggest battle of the war when he launches a surprise attack into liberated Belgium.

videos.title: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
videos.description: New colorized footage and testimony reveals the cost of victory, the aftermath of war and the liberation of the camps and the destruction of Germany.

videos.title: WWII Battles in Color
videos.description: Rare archive footage charts the German Army in 1940 as it unleashes a new Blitzkrieg tactic.

videos.title: WWII Battles in Color
videos.description: Cameras roll as Nazi Germany launches an all-out assault on the Soviet Union.

videos.title: WWII Battles in Color
videos.description: Footage of life and death on the battlefield of El Alamein and behind the lines in the African desert.

videos.title: WWII Battles in Color
videos.description: The story of the greatest tank battle the world has ever seen.

videos.title: WWII Battles in Color
videos.description: Eyewitness accounts from those who fought in the US military's bloodiest battle on the European front in World War II.

videos.title: WWII Battles in Color
videos.description: Incredible footage, colorized for the first time, chronicles the final days of the Third Reich and the brutal battle for Berlin, though German defeat looked certain. Nazi soldiers persisted in fighting despite the inevitability of their downfall.

videos.title: Battle of Midway: The True Story
videos.description: America's first victory in the Pacific during World War II is retold from the vantage point of the three U.S. attack planes as they overcame the enemy ambush to face off against the Mitsubishi A6M Zero, a long-range fighter, in the air.

videos.title: The Battle of Normandy: 85 Days in Hell
videos.description: On D-Day, Allied forces land in Normandy, France, to beat back the German troops and liberate France; previously unseen archival footage captures the 85-day struggle to liberate Europe and includes rare images of the battle itself.

videos.title: WWII by Drone
videos.description: More than 75 years since the historic Allied invasion; Conflict archeologists uncover hidden evidence on and off the shores of Normandy, thanks to drone technology; One team examines the site of a British commando raid that liberated Port-en-Bessin.

videos.title: The Blitz: Days That Changed WWII
videos.description: The story of Nazi Germany's unprecedented aerial assault on Britain's major cities and how the resilience of its citizens became a news event.

videos.title: The Battle of Normandy: 85 Days in Hell
videos.description: On D-Day, Allied forces land in Normandy, France, to beat back the German troops and liberate France; previously unseen archival footage captures the 85-day struggle to liberate Europe and includes rare images of the battle itself.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: The South's famous landmarks, historical milestones and unique culture.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A journey over America's western landscape featuring "wild" history and stories of colorful characters.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A soaring tour over Washington, D.C. explores the unique landscape, rich history and colorful story of the Nation's Capital.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A flying tour of Michigan's cultural landmarks, including Motown, the Great Lakes, the automobile industry and more.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: Tour the Wisconsin State Capitol and Milwaukee City Hall, once the tallest building in the world.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A cross-country flight over icy landscapes in Alaska's Denali, vast wetlands in Florida's Everglades, and over 100 million acres of badlands, deserts, and mountains.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: The Wright Brothers gave the state its slogan "First in Flight"; civil rights leaders in Greensboro; NASCAR.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: Northern state's green forests; red-painted barns and sugar maples.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A cross-country flight across America reveals the nation's most iconic industries, the people behind them and the stories of how they came to be.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A flight over North and South Dakota reveals the shared history and the vast differences of these sibling states.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A tour over two U.S. territories, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: The stories and sights of Hawaii's major islands.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: A flight over Northern California explores ancient forests, timeless coasts, golden cities and the region's pioneering spirit.

videos.title: Aerial Thailand
videos.description: Central Thailand is a land of ancient kingdoms and royal power, a striking unity of old and new, tied together by the majestic Chao Phraya River, a defining force winding through the heart of the region.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: An aerial tour of Nevada; the state's deserts, ghost towns, neon cities and Hoover Dam; its history built on epic booms and busts.

videos.title: Aerial Thailand
videos.description: Central Thailand is a land of ancient kingdoms and royal power, a striking unity of old and new, tied together by the majestic Chao Phraya River, a defining force winding through the heart of the region.

videos.title: Aerial America
videos.description: The world's largest volcanic island; Iceland's landscapes, forged by fire and ice; a tour over Alaska, the residents it attracts and the wildlife that thrives in these unique surroundings.

videos.title: Aerial Thailand
videos.description: Central Thailand is a land of ancient kingdoms and royal power, a striking unity of old and new, tied together by the majestic Chao Phraya River, a defining force winding through the heart of the region.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: In September 2006, a brand-new legacy business jet collides with a Boeing 737 over the Amazon forest.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: UPS Airlines Flight 1354 clips the tops of trees and crashes into a hillside about one nautical mile short of the runway during final approach to Birmingham-Shuttlesworth International Airport in Alabama.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: In one of the world's busiest airports, a large passenger plane crashes into a smaller one; a 1986 midair crash between planes near Los Angeles brings attention to disturbing congestion at airports.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: Design innovations evolve as a result of terrible air disasters due to pressurization failure or explosive decompression.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: A Boeing 737 leaving Panama City crashes into one of the most remote and treacherous jungles on the planet.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: Alaska Airlines 261 nosedives into the Pacific leaving investigators stumped; a rare storm and a deadly design flaw intersect cause American Eagle 4184 to fall from the sky; investigators suspect a fatal flaw in the Boeing 737.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: When basketball legend Kobe Bryant is killed in a helicopter crash in Calabasas, investigators examine the data, the wreckage, and the pilot's actions for clues.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: A design flaw sends American Eagle Flight 41-84 smashing into a cornfield outside of Chicago, killing all 68 people on board.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: On 12 November 2001, just two months after the September 11 attacks, American Airlines Flight 587 spirals out of control shortly after taking off from John F. Kennedy Airport and crashes into Queens.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: British Midland Flight 92 slams into Britain's busy M1 motorway, and it seems like a rare case of dual engine failure, but investigators learn the real cause was a tragic misunderstanding.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: When a commuter turboprop plane crashes at an Irish airport, investigators uncover a startling gap in aviation safety.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: On 9 August 2007, Air Moorea Flight 1121 crashed shortly after taking off from Moorea Airport in French Polynesia, killing all 19 passengers and the pilot.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: A surface-to-air missile cripples a cargo plane after it takes off from Baghdad International Airport.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: Bad weather and a series of errors lead to the 2001 crash of a plane on its approach to Zurich Airport.

videos.title: Air Disasters
videos.description: Saudi Airways and Kazakhstan Airlines jets hit each other at 14,000 feet sending both planes spiraling to the ground.

videos.title: How Did They Fix That?
videos.description: Mike is in Indonesia, where sinking Jakarta battles floods with seawalls, pumps and reservoirs, while the new capital Nusantara is being built as a sponge city designed to absorb, store and reuse water instead of fighting it.

videos.title: How Did They Fix That?
videos.description: In Grindavik, Iceland, crews repair earthquake fissures, build lava barriers and track magma, gases and ground movement while divers inspect a damaged harbor pier in a town shaped by ongoing eruptions.

videos.title: How Did They Fix That?
videos.description: At the Panama Canal, crews repair dam and lock gates, dredge the Culebra Cut, maintain electric mules and restore the watershed while battling drought, erosion and rising salinity.

videos.title: How Did They Fix That?
videos.description: In Southern California, crews rebuild after the 2025 wildfires, cutting firebreaks, repairing emergency water systems, hardening roads and power lines and building fire-resistant homes before the next firestorm.

videos.title: How Did They Fix That?
videos.description: Mike is in Cambodia, where crews are racing to preserve the ancient temples of Angkor.

videos.title: How Did They Fix That?
videos.description: Mike works with the U.S. Army in Germany inside the massive fix facility the MAK, Maintenance Activity Kaiserslautern, as teams repair over one hundred Bradley fighting vehicles, then embeds with troops in a massive two-week-long battle exercise.
